description: This Lua script implements a particle collision simulation involving bouncing balls. It defines a 'Ball' class with methods to initialize ball properties, detect and respond to collisions with other balls and the window boundaries, and render the balls on the screen. The 'setup' function initializes the simulation with multiple balls, and the 'draw' function updates and visualizes the simulation frame-by-frame, including user interaction via the mouse.

classes.name: Ball
classes.description: Represents a moving ball object in the simulation with properties for position, velocity, color, and collision handling methods.

methods.name: Ball:init
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the ball's position, velocity, color, and radius.

methods.name: Ball:collision
methods.description: Detects and responds to collisions with other balls and window boundaries, including interaction with mouse position.

methods.name: Ball:move
methods.description: Updates the ball's position based on velocity, applies collision detection, and damping.

methods.name: Ball:draw
methods.description: Renders the ball on the screen.
